blurbs.motw: Lil Fridge edged Puka Deez... 127.35 to 124.49 in an upset. Down 13.64 after Sunday night, they took the lead back on Monday as Derrick Henry scored 16.5. The losing side left Pat Freiermuth's 10.5 on the bench behind Mike Gesicki's 1.4, a swap that would have flipped the result. The recent adds split the difference: the waiver-claim Packers defense managed 3.75, and trade pickup Josh Allen posted 23.34. Woody Marks was hurt in the 3rd quarter at CLE and is now listed Out (Concussion), while Travis Kelce is now listed Questionable (Ankle). The winners climb to the top of the standings, while the losers hold their spot and salvage a split by beating the median.
blurbs.game_changer: Christian McCaffrey ranked 1 of 31 among started running backs this week. He piled up 161 receiving yards in the 49ers' win over the Cowboys, and he scored through the air and on the ground. Lil Fridge penciled him in for 20.56 and got 44.3. Not bad for one guy. Against Puka Deez... he outscored the 2.86 margin on his own, so without him, that is a loss.
blurbs.awards: Unsolicited Dak Picks left Dak Prescott on the bench for 35.42, the most of any bench player this week. George Pickens beat his projection by 26.85 for them, and they still lost by 18.44. Drake Maye finished last among started QBs, and Maye d'force B with U won anyway. Over on NFC Least, the new pickup Chase Brown scored 24.3 on an 11.65 projection.
blurbs.position_leaders: Christian McCaffrey led every started running back with 44.3 for Lil Fridge. Patrick Mahomes topped the quarterbacks at 35.42 for To Infinity and Bijan.
